record.label: Cost relative to kickmix and the Häner baseline
record.statement: The paper reports a cost reduction of about $11\%$ relative to the circuit of cost $415{,}200$ that could still be expressed in kickmix, and a factor of about 290 relative to the Häner baseline estimate.
record.boundary: Relative to the reported kickmix cost of $415{,}200$, the Lean upper bound of $369{,}800$ implies a reduction of at least $10.9\%$. The Häner lower estimate divided by the same upper bound is $107{,}941{,}120/369{,}800=291.890535\ldots$, which the paper reports as a factor of about 290. Appendix F.2 estimates the baseline error at about $10^{-6}$. Lean proves the $1.25\times10^{-7}$ bound for the final circuit.
